description: List the step-by-step guides to the nopaque web app, and the reference pages (pricing, FAQ). Each entry has a slug, a kind (guide or reference), a group, a title and a one-line summary. Use when: someone asks how to do, set up or configure something in the web app, or what something costs, and you need to know whether a guide covers it. Pass a slug to getGuide for the full text. If no entry covers the question, there is no guide for it: say so rather than guessing at screens. The same for every workspace.
name: listGuides

kind.description: `guide` is a step-by-step walkthrough of the web app. `reference` is a page of facts such as pricing.

slug.description: The name to pass to getGuide.

summary.example: Script a call step by step and check the IVR answers correctly

title: List UI Guides
